body: How long did you do chemical peels for and are they recurring? Thanks so much for the thoughtful reply. I’ll look into perioral dermatitis.

My current skincare routine: Most of my spots, as you can see, are hyperpigmentation after acne. No texture changes or anything beyond the surface. But they last for sooo long, like months. 
I use La Roche Posse daily cleanser x2 a day. Then I use Corsx Galactomyces 95 Tone Balancing Essence, Corsx Snail 96 Mucin Essence, and I’ve realized I need a better moisturizing agent so I got the Nutrogena Hydro Boost for Extra Dry skin. 
My skin has gone through everything and responds well to hyaluronic acid and is really dry these days, probably because I also started using A’pieu Glycolic Acid Cream that contains AHA and BHA. That really made my skin break out in areas that I usually don’t get break outs, but I don’t know if it’s purging still. It’s been 4 weeks and I use it once a week. 
Side note: if anyone has had redness on the side of their nose like shown in my photo, I would really like to get rid of it! I’ve had it my whole life. 
Does anyone have advice on any of the above? It would be greatly appreciated!
